name: Blackfang Zuzubar
description: Solid black shapes with no outline and no mercy. Every curve ends in a point.

designs.title: Swirling Sun
designs.description: Ten curved blades spinning around a starred ring. Solid black and readable from far away.

designs.title: Hook Spiral
designs.description: One thick spiral tapering to nothing, barbed along its outer edge. Wraps a shoulder well.

designs.title: Fang Heart
designs.description: A heart built from two fanged curves that nearly meet. Mirrored, sharp and heavy.

designs.title: Twin Flames
designs.description: Mirrored black flames rising from a single point. Made for the centre of the back.

designs.title: Manta Glide
designs.description: A manta ray drawn as sweeping blades with cut-out highlights and a long thin tail.
